_note: The fake mesh for a run against meshmaster.dk's compose stack (tools/host-run.ps1,
docs/host.md section 7). It is deliberately not the CI scenario: every key here is one the
**seeded register of that stack already holds**, so the fake repeater and the row on the
server are the same thing and the assertions can be made on both ends.
exitNode.publicKey   the companion key the seeded exit node 'seed: Risskov window' already
reports. Reporting a different one is stored, flagged and audited, and
suspends admin routing through the exit node (spec/SECURITY.md 6) - so
the harness stands in for that exit node rather than becoming a new one.
repeaters[0]         'Grenaa Chimney #1', whose public key the seeder sets to its number as
two hex digits, thirty-two times (meshmaster.dk docs/dev/local.md).
`acceptAnyPassword` is the one concession, and src/host/HostScenario.h says exactly what it
gives up: the stack will not tell a script what password it stored for a repeater, because
revealing a credential is a gated action and a personal access token is always refused one.

exitNode._note: the seeded exit node's own companionPublicKey
